actual_scope: Can ten further helper splits (the lemma of #5599, applied to the shared native word in #6916), on the word of #6919, improve the complete signed invoice over #6919?
scope_change_reason: Same native construction, per-port root pair, block-diagonal caller (78 roles, 18 joint contacts), A6 declaration and BIT line as #6919; only the word changes: 62,921 events, 1441 public registers (400 mains, 1041 helpers), ten further helper splits over the #6919 word (strictly nested frames, one credit per helper, T change counted, the multiset of MOVEs and so P unchanged), and a rewritten event list (ADD 53,150 against 65,902, SCALE 3,288 against 2,180). Correctness rests on the exact replay of the final word, a second replay mod 2^61-1, the replay as streams over F_p[i], the native chart-change maps and the joint caller. Owned registers read mains 19 times (16 in #6919), peak owned fields 36 (30 in #6919: the owned INIT and CLEAR events sit in a different order); largest |q| 6927/2, coefficient bits 15/11, no ADD at |q| >= 2^12. Raw counts 962,308,192 / 970,367,440 / 981,275,368, below 10^9; the LAMBDA events are inside the reviewed upper count through the caller envelope, and the deliberate second charge of #6913 (12,560,000 at our mix count) gives 993,835,368, also below 10^9. Logarithm power minimum 2211, written 2212 (carrier 153). The BIT saving of the open #6726 (.00376669) is necessary. LAMBDA priced as ordinary work is a review question. Gain: +0.245% over #6919.
